svg.text: spin to your pen · pull the slide · it drops into the tray. 3 printed parts, no fasteners, no springs.
drum just drops into the open bearings — lift it out to refill
the drum clicks each chamber to the drop station
slide the shutter out ~3 cm — one pen drops
it settles against the front lip; pick it up
slide the shutter back; spin to the next
• drop-in axle (was a snap-fit) — lift out to refill
• one sliding shutter replaces the trapdoor + hinge + sprung latch
• no springs to fatigue; the only flex is the optional index click
